summary: Iter317 — Frontend-only smoke/render parity check for 10 admin pages (LOCATION + PROMOTIONS sections). All 10 routes render correctly after admin login. Zero JS pageerrors, no error boundaries, no blank screens. Google Maps load on /admin/gods-view and /admin/heat-view.

per_page_results.evidence: Heading 'Geo Fence Locations', 4 zones configurees (Paris Centre, Fort-de-France, Aeroport CDG, Zone Restreinte Test), 'Ajouter une zone' button visible.
Same AdminGeoFence component (aliased route) — renders identical Geo Fence Locations UI without crash.
AdminAirport renders with main heading; 0 pageerrors.
AdminServiceConfig(serviceKey='country') renders with main heading; 0 pageerrors.
Heading 'State / Region Settings', 'Region par defaut' = Martinique, 'Regions actives' = Ile-de-France, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Sauvegarder button.

Heading "God's View", tabs Rides/Deliveries/Jobs, status counters A(17)/N(0)/P(0)/R(0)/D(0), live Google Map with traffic layer renders, driver list (Ahmed Diallo, Sophie Lefevre, Pierre Dupont...). map elements detected=19.
Heading 'Heat View', 'Densite (17 points) — actualise toutes les 30s', Toggle Heatmap button, Plan/Satellite controls, Google Map renders. map elements detected=4.
AdminPromocodes renders with main heading; 0 pageerrors.
Heading 'Gift Cards Management', '4 templates disponibles' (Classique, Anniversaire, Felicitations, Merci) all 'Active'.

critical_code_review_comments: Route alias note: /admin/restricted reuses AdminGeoFence (same component as /admin/geo-fence). If product expects a distinct 'restricted zones only' filter, consider passing a prop like <AdminGeoFence mode='restricted' /> so the two menu items show different lists.
Heat View shows a hardcoded-looking 'Densite (17 points)' label even though the data is dynamic — consider showing the actual count returned by the API to avoid stale 17 when no points are available.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 admin pages render with main content; 0 pageerrors; both Google Map pages load tiles)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: /login -> click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' -> click [data-testid=login-email-btn] -> fill input[type=email]/input[type=password] -> Enter -> lands on /admin. Then page.goto each /admin/<slug> works. Map pages need ~6s wait for Google Maps tiles. /admin/restricted is currently an alias of /admin/geo-fence (same AdminGeoFence component). The 401s in console come from background fetches before auth context is hydrated and do NOT cause pageerror events or blank screens.
